title: Positive clopen refinement with factorization
statement: Let X be a topological space, K and C abelian sheaves, ι : K → C monic, and isoC : C ≅ the constant integer sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For a finite family U of compact opens and any map g from the coproduct of j_(U_i)! Z to K [def-sc-abelian-open-extension-by-zero], there are finitely many compact opens A, positive integer labels c, and maps f from j_(A_i)! Z to K with unit images c under ι followed by isoC, such that g factors through the coproduct map Sigma.desc f. No epimorphy is assumed or asserted.

source.place: Lemma 0A38, first two proof paragraphs; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0A38

proof.text: Obtain a finite signed partition record, including the equations relating its components to the original unit sections. Apply the gluing factorization lemma to that record and package its compactness, positive labels, component maps and factorization into the target existential.

proof_origin.place: First proof paragraph; reduction to the finite signed partition construction and its coproduct factorization.

theorem constantSubsheaf_positive_refinement
    (X : TopCat.{u}) (K C : Sheaf AddCommGrpCat X) (ι : K ⟶ C) [Mono ι]
    (isoC : C ≅ (constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))
    (m : ℕ) (U : Fin m → Opens X)
    (hU : ∀ i, IsCompact (U i : Set X))
    (g : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶ K) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (A : Fin n → Opens X),
      (∀ i, IsCompact (A i : Set X)) ∧
      ∃ (c : Fin n → ℕ), (∀ i, 0 < c i) ∧
      ∃ (f : ∀ i, (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A i)).obj
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) ⟶ K),
        (∃ l : (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (U i)).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (U i)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))) ⟶
          (∐ fun i => (abelianOpenExtensionByZero (A i)).obj
          ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
            AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))),
          l ≫ Sigma.desc f = g) ∧ ∀ i,
        (ι ≫ isoC.hom).hom.app (op (A i))
      ((f i).hom.app (op (A i)) (abelianOpenExtensionSection (A i)
      ((constantSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
        AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ))) (A i) le_rfl
      ((toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))
        ((Functor.const (Opens ((Opens.toTopCat X).obj (A i)))ᵒᵖ).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
        (op ((Opens.map (A i).inclusion').obj (A i))) (ULift.up 1)))) =
      (toSheafify (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      ((Functor.const (Opens X)ᵒᵖ).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of (ULift.{u} ℤ)))).app
      (op (A i)) (ULift.up (c i : ℤ))
